about.title: Brewed in Guangdong, served worldwide.
about.subtitle: Duifei Trade is the export arm of Qingyuan Haojiu Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. and Guangzhou Hejiu Liquor Co., Ltd.
paragraphs: Based in Fogang, Qingyuan — the heart of Guangdong's liquor belt — we operate licensed brewing facilities producing Cantonese-style baijiu, herbal infused liquor and fruit rice wine.

Our brands include Dao Jiu Weng, Jiang Shang Yue, Qing Ye Wu Chen and Mo Xiang Wang. We also offer full OEM/ODM services for overseas distributors looking to bring authentic Chinese liquor to their markets.
